info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Payment Rail Operations Management API
info.description: The Payment Rail Operations Management API facilitates the execution of various operational actions related to payment processing. This endpoint supports the initiation of workflows that manage payment transactions across different rail systems. Typically utilized by financial institutions and fintech developers, this API enables efficient handling of payment operations, ensuring seamless integration with banking systems. Use cases include adjusting transaction parameters, managing payment statuses, and orchestrating payment flows to enhance overall transaction management.
